{{Top|leg}}
'''Multi-sensors''' were used in voice-activated security systems, and registered a voice's accent, inflection, tone, stress, and other pattern characteristics. Multi-sensors, combined with super-encryption processes, made voice-activated security systems difficult to bypass.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
